hazards.title: Unprotected floor opening
hazards.description: A large rectangular floor opening in the lower right foreground has no cover, guardrail, or barricade around it, exposing workers walking through the area to a fall into the pit.
hazards.category: Working at Heights and Fall Protection

hazards.title: Worker near top of stepladder
hazards.description: A worker on the orange stepladder at left appears to be standing on or near the top step while reaching overhead into the cable tray, risking loss of balance and a fall.

hazards.title: Work inside open switchgear
hazards.description: A worker at left is working directly inside open electrical switchgear with exposed wiring and components, with no visible lockout/tagout devices or arc-flash protective clothing.

hazards.title: Extension cord across walkway
hazards.description: A yellow extension cord runs loosely across the open floor from the switchgear area into the floor opening, creating a trip hazard in the main walkway.

hazards.title: Materials staged in aisle
hazards.description: Palletized materials and cable tray sections are staged in the central aisle and near the workbench, narrowing walkways and adding trip and obstruction hazards.
